day_local: Jimcaha Toddobaadka 31-aad ee Waqtiga Caadiga ah
greeting: Magaca Aabbaha iyo Wiilka iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ah. Nabadda Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix ha idinla jirto.
penitential: Rabbiyow, naxariiso. Masiixow, naxariiso. Rabbiyow, naxariiso.
psalm_response: Aynu ugu faraxsanaanno inaan tagno guriga Rabbiga.
homily:
Bal ka fikir sawirka qof taagan meel sare oo uu ka eegayo qorshe weyn oo uu rabo inuu fuliyo. Wuxuu gacanta ku hayaa qalabkii, wuxuu hayaa qorshihii, laakiin wuxuu dareemayaa in waqtigu uu cidhiidhi ku yahay. Injiilka maanta, waxaan ku aragnaa wakiilkaas oo la kulmay xaqiiqada ah in shaqadiisii ay dhammaatay. Wuxuu gartay inuu u baahan yahay inuu si degdeg ah u dhaqmo si uu u helo mustaqbal ka duwan. Waa sheeko nagu dhiirrigelinaysa inaan ka fikirno waxa dhabta ah ee muhiimka u ah nolosheena.

Benjamin Vo, wiilkeenna qaaliga ah, wuxuu ahaa qof nolosha u arkaayay sida safar weyn oo u baahan in si taxaddar leh loo qorsheeyo. Waxaad ogtihiin inuu ahaa wiil maskaxdiisu ay ku dhex noolayd dunida tiknoolajiyadda, koodhka, iyo riyada ah inuu abuuro 'con chim airlines'—shirkaddaas yar ee uu mar walba qosol iyo dhoola caddayn ku xasuusin jiray markii uu ka sheekaynayey. Laakiin maanta, waxaan rabaa inaan idin xusuusiyo hal shay oo ka mid ah nolosha Ben oo muujinaysa inuu fahmay 'maalgashiga' runta ah ee nolosha. Xusuuso markii uu ahaa 15 jir, ee uu u sheegay waalidkiis inuu rabayo inuu bixiyo lacagtiisa sanduuqa ku jirta si uu u caawiyo adeerkiis William oo xanuunsanaa? Ma uusan jebin sanduuqa, mana loo baahnayn in la jebiyo, laakiin rabitaankaas saafi ah ee ahaa inuu diyaar u yahay inuu dhiibo wax kasta oo uu haysto si uu qof u caawiyo waa calaamad muujinaysa jacayl aan xad lahayn. Wuxuu ahaa wiil diyaar u ahaa inuu 'maalgashado' jacaylka, xataa marka uusan haysan wax badan.

Alan iyo Thao, waan ogahay in afartan bilood ay yihiin kuwo culus. Waxaan rabaa inaan si daacad ah idiinla hadlo. Waxaa jira saacado marka aad guriga dhexdiisa dareemaysaan in booska Ben uu yahay mid aan marnaba buuxsami karin. Waxaa laga yaabaa inay jiraan waqtiyo aad naftiina ku eedaysaan, ama aad is weydiisataan haddii aad wax ka qaban karteen. Fadlan, halkan ku hakada. Maanta, waxaan rabaa inaan idin sheego runta: Ilaah wuu idin arkaa. Xanuunka noocan ah waa mid ka baxsan awoodda bini'aadamka, mana jiro qof masuul ka ah. Sida Ciise uu u sheegay kuwii weydiiyey cidda dembaabtay ee wiilka indhaha la' dhalay, 'Neither this man nor his parents.' Xanuunka noocan ah waa mid ka baxsan awoodda bini'aadamka, mana jiro qof masuul ka ah. Waxaad ahaydeen waalid qumman, jacaylkiinnuna waa kan weli Ben la socda. Ha is-eedeynin; Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu ku jiraa gacmaha Aabbaha oo aanay jirin wax dhib ah. Waxaad dareemi kartaa xorriyadda inaad baroorato adigoon dareemin dambi, waayo jacaylkaaga ayaa ahaa kan ugu weyn.

Bawlos, akhriska koowaad, wuxuu inoo sheegayaa: 'Laakiin dhalashadeenna samada ayay ku taallaa.' Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil fahmay in jacaylka uu u qabo qoyskiisa iyo Ilaah uu ka qiimo badan yahay wax kasta oo dunidan ah. Wuxuu ahaa wiil si dhab ah u doondoonayay Ilaah, xataa markii uu ku dhex jiray xanuunka. Wuxuu ahaa wiilka ku yiri Aabbihiis riyadii uu ku arkay: 'Baaba, test nào con cũng qua hết.' Haa, Ben wuu gudbay, wuxuuna hadda joogaa meel uu nabad ku helo. Wuxuu hadda ka mid yahay 'carruurta iftiinka' ee Bawlos ka hadlayo, kuwaas oo aan ku mashquulin waxyaabaha dhulka, balse indhahooda ku haya samada.

Ryan, walaal qaali ah, adiga oo maanta halkan jooga, xusuuso in Ben uu weli ku jiro wadnahaaga. Adiga iyo isaga waxaa idin mideeyay jacayl aan dhimanayn. Ha ka baqina inaad nolosha ku raaxaysataan, waayo Ben wuxuu rabaa inaad faraxdaan. Wuxuu rabaa inaad noqoto wiilka geesiga ah ee uu mar walba jeclaa. Sida gacantii uu Ben u fidiyay qoyskiisa, jacaylka uu kuu hayo wuxuu sii wadi doonaa inuu ku dhex koro nolol maalmeedkaaga, isagoo ku siinaya xoog iyo rajo. Waxaad tihiin qoys midaysan, jacaylka idin ka dhexeeya waa mid aan marnaba dhimanayn.

Markaad maanta ka baxaysaan meeshan, qaada hal shay oo yar oo aad gacanta ku haysaan: Ha is-edeynin, hana ka cabsanin inaad u dhiibto xanuunkaaga Ilaah. Ben wuxuu hadda ku sugan yahay nabadda gacmaha Aabbaha. Marka aad dareento cidlo, xusuuso in geedka noloshaada uu weli Ilaah daryeelayo, isagoo ku daraya jacayl maalin kasta. Waxaad tahay mid qaali ah. Waxaad tahay mid la jecel yahay. Ben wuxuu idin leeyahay inaan la idin iloobin. Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu idin jecel yahay. Aamiin.
spiritual_communion: Ciise, waxaan aaminsanahay inaad ku jirto Sakramental-ka Quduuska ah. Waxaan kuu jecelahay wax kasta oo ka sarreeya, waxaana rabaa inaan ku qaato naftayda. Maadaama aanan hadda si muuqata kuu qaadan karin, fadlan naftayda ku soo gal ruux ahaan. Waxaan isku duubayaa sida haddii aad mar horeba joogto, waxaana naftayda u hurayaa adiga gebi ahaanba. Weligaa ha ii oggolaan inaan kaa fogaado. Aamiin.
closing: Rabbigu ha idin barakeeyo oo ha idin ilaaliyo. Nabadda Masiixa ha idinla jirto had iyo goor.
standing_petitions: U ducaynta Benjamin iyo dhammaan kuwii naga horreeyay, inay nabad ku nastaan iftiinka Masiixa.
U ducaynta dhammaan qoysaska murugaysan, inay Ilaah siiyo rajo, samir, iyo kalsooni ay ku sii wadaan noloshooda.

readings.label: Akhrinta Koowaad
readings.text: Walaalayaalow, ila mid noqda oo ku dayda kuwa sidaas u socda, sidayda oo kale, waayo waxaad nagu leedihiin tusaale. Waayo, sidaan marar badan idiin sheegay, oo haddana ilmo ku leh idiin sheegayo, dad badan baa socda kuwaas oo ah cadaawayaasha iskutallaabta Masiixa. Dhammaadkoodu waa baabba', ilaahooduna waa calooshooda, ammaantooduna waa ceebtooda, waxayna ku fikiraan waxyaabaha dhulka. Laakiin dhalashadeenna samada ayay ku taallaa, meeshaas oo aynu ka sugayno Badbaadiye, oo ah Rabbiga Ciise Masiix. Isagu wuxuu beddeli doonaa jidhkeenna hooseeya si uu ugu ekaado jidhkiisa ammaanta leh, xooggiisa uu wax walba ugu hoosaysiin karo aawadiis. Sidaas daraaddeed, walaalahaygii aan jeclahay oo aan u xiisay, oo ah farxaddayda iyo taajkayga, sidaas ugu adkaysta Rabbiga, gacaliyeey.

readings.label: Sabuurka
readings.text: R. Aynu ugu faraxsanaanno inaan tagno guriga Rabbiga. Waan farxay markay igu yidhaahdeen, 'Waxaanu u kici doonnaa guriga Rabbiga.' Hadda cagahayagu waxay taagan yihiin iridahaaga, Yeruusaalemay. R. Aynu ugu faraxsanaanno inaan tagno guriga Rabbiga. Yeruusaalem waxaa loo dhisay sidii magaalo si wanaagsan isugu xidhan. Meeshaas waxaa u kici doona qabiilada, qabiilada Rabbiga. R. Aynu ugu faraxsanaanno inaan tagno guriga Rabbiga. Sida loo amray reer binu Israa'iil, inay Rabbiga magiciisa u mahadceliyaan. Waxaa meeshaas loo dhigay kuraastii xukunka, kuraastii reer Daa'uud. R. Aynu ugu faraxsanaanno inaan tagno guriga Rabbiga.

readings.label: Injiilka
readings.text: Ciise wuxuu xertiisa ku yidhi, 'Nin taajir ahaa baa lahaa wakiil, waxaana loo sheegay inuu hantidiisii qasaariyey. Markaasuu u yeedhay oo ku yidhi, Maxaan waxan kaa maqlayaa? Xisaabta wakiilnimadaada ii dhiib, waayo mar dambe wakiil ii ahaan maysid. Wakiilkii wuxuu naftiisa ku yidhi, Maxaan samayn doonaa, maadaama sayidkaygu wakiilnimadii iga qaadayo? Awood uma lihi inaan qodo, ceebna waan ka qabaa inaan baryootamo. Waan ogahay waxaan samayn doono, si markii wakiilnimadii lagaa qaado, ay dadku guryahooda iigu soo dhoweeyaan. Markaasuu u yeedhay mid kasta oo sayidkiisii deyn ku lahaa, wuxuuna kii hore ku yidhi, Immisaad sayidkayga ku leedahay? Wuxuuna yidhi, Boqol cabbir oo saliid saytuun ah. Wuxuuna ku yidhi, Qaado waraaqdaada, oo fadhiiso, oo si degdeg ah u qor konton. Markaasuu kan kale ku yidhi, Adiguna immisaad ku leedahay? Wuxuuna yidhi, Boqol cabbir oo sarreen ah. Wuxuuna ku yidhi, Qaado waraaqdaada, oo qor siddeetan. Sayidkiina wuxuu ammaanay wakiilkii aan daacadda ahayn, waayo wuxuu u dhaqmay si caqli leh. Waayo, carruurta dunidan ayaa ka caqli badan carruurta iftiinka marka ay la macaamilayaan dadka ay isku jiilka yihiin.'

day: Friday of the Thirty-first Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - mom and I have been missing you a lot.   Saw you a few times in my dreams last few weeks! Come and say hi daily okay?
Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!
